description: Legal merged Sorcerer/Monk HLA selection in a real ToB campaign.
prerequisites: Real ToB-capable game data and an active ToB campaign, not a fabricated public fixture.

instructions: Open the real level-up screen and compare the displayed merged Sorcerer/Monk choices with legal entries from the installed table.
